Key points from the transcript:
1. It's about the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections and by-elections for National Assembly members in 14 regions.
2. As of 1 PM, voter turnout was around 46%, which is 7.7 percentage points higher than 4 years ago.
3. By 2 PM, it reached 48.9%, 8.2 points higher than the same time in the previous election (40.7%).
4. Regional variations noted: Daegu (49.8% vs previous final 43.2%), Busan (48.5% vs previous final 49.1%), Gwangju/Jeonnam (52.5% vs previous low 37.7%), Jeonbuk (54.2% vs previous final 48.7%).
5. The high turnout in competitive regions (battlegrounds) is notable.
6. Discussion about early voting vs main voting between ruling and opposition parties.
